title: Exit queue / withdrawal delay
requirements: withdrawal delay policy is append-only, governance-published and nonzero
exit requests snapshot exact delay policy revision and commitment
later policy revisions cannot accelerate or extend an already-requested exit
only the immutable worker owner or stored verifier authority may request/withdraw its position
verifier authority rotation cannot strand or transfer historical collateral exit rights
requesting exit keeps all unwithdrawn collateral active and slashable through the delay
top-ups are rejected once a position is exiting
withdrawals are batched across immutable collateral tranches to avoid unbounded-loop lockout
each withdrawn tranche is released and claimed through canonical 420Vault accounting
remaining unwithdrawn tranches remain active/slashable after partial withdrawal
completed withdrawal zeros active/slashable amounts and deactivates the position
Vault beneficiary remains immutable and no arbitrary recipient is introduced
security_boundaries: CMP-1.5.4 does not authorize slashing or select slash recipients
CMP-1.5.4 does not introduce rewards or Treasury authority
release/claim authority is exercised only for tranches already bound to the exact collateral position
withdrawal operation IDs are domain-separated by chain, source contract, position and tranche
reentrant stake/withdraw/exit attempts are rejected while withdrawal is executing

milestone.rationale: exit lifecycle and a shared delay-policy dependency now modify both worker and verifier collateral sources and their Vault release/claim path.
